Fact.Name: New clean vehicle credit transferred to the dealer (Schedule A (Form 8936) line 4a, Part II)
Fact.Description: The amount of the NEW clean vehicle credit (IRC §30D) the taxpayer transferred to a registered dealer at the time of sale, from the seller's report — Schedule A (Form 8936) line 4a, for a Part II (new clean vehicle) transfer. When the taxpayer no longer qualifies for the credit, this full amount is repaid on Schedule 2 line 1b. Integer cents; Min 0. Optional — absent means no new clean vehicle credit was transferred, so no line-1b repayment.

Fact.Name: Previously-owned clean vehicle credit transferred to the dealer (Schedule A (Form 8936) line 4a, Part IV)
Fact.Description: The amount of the PREVIOUSLY-OWNED (used) clean vehicle credit (IRC §25E) the taxpayer transferred to a registered dealer at the time of sale, from the seller's report — Schedule A (Form 8936) line 4a, for a Part IV (used clean vehicle) transfer. When the taxpayer no longer qualifies, this full amount is repaid on Schedule 2 line 1c. The used credit is itself capped at $4,000 (Schedule A line 16), so a transfer is at most $4,000. Integer cents; Min 0. Optional — absent means no used clean vehicle credit was transferred.

Fact.Name: Additional new clean vehicles beyond the legacy single-vehicle inputs
Fact.Description: One item per additional new clean vehicle placed in service in 2025 and reported on its own Schedule A (Form 8936), after the legacy root new-vehicle inputs are used for at most one vehicle. Each item keeps its own VIN, acquisition date, placed-in-service date, seller tentative-credit amount, and qualification answer. The collection may be empty. An opened item with a missing required field leaves Schedule 3 line 6f incomplete rather than silently losing that vehicle. The separate 2025 acquisition cutoff is computed per item; see /additionalNewCleanVehicles/*/personalUseCreditCandidate.

Fact.Name: Additional new clean vehicle VIN (Schedule A line 2)
Fact.Description: The uppercase 17-character VIN on this additional vehicle's separate Schedule A (Form 8936), line 2. Required for each opened item; this is the statutory per-vehicle identity on the return. The fact graph checks that it is well-formed, unique within the additional- vehicle collection, and not the already-entered primary Schedule A VIN.

Fact.Name: Additional new clean vehicle acquisition date for the 2025 cutoff (Form 8936 Schedule A line 5)
Fact.Description: The date this vehicle was acquired for federal clean-vehicle-credit purposes: the date a written binding contract was entered into AND a payment was made (a nominal down payment or trade-in counts). Required for an opened item. The schedule's deadline is strict: 2025-09-30 qualifies and 2025-10-01 does not.

Fact.Name: Additional new clean vehicle placed-in-service date (Schedule A line 3)
Fact.Description: The date this additional vehicle was placed in service, as entered on its own Schedule A (Form 8936), line 3. Required for each opened item and must fall in 2025.

Fact.Name: Additional new vehicle meets the non-computable personal-credit gates
Fact.Description: Answer Yes only if this identified vehicle otherwise qualifies for the new clean vehicle personal-use credit: Schedule A line 5 new-vehicle status; line 8a not resold within 30 days; line 8e acquired for use or lease and not for resale (and not leased from another person); all applicable §30D manufacturer, battery, mineral, and price rules; and 0% business or investment use so the full personal-use amount routes directly to Schedule 3 line 6f. Also attest that the vehicle meets the remaining non-computable statutory definition, is used primarily in the United States, and the taxpayer cannot be claimed as a dependent. The acquisition cutoff and placed-in-service year are checked from this item's dates, the shared MAGI test is computed once for the taxpayer, and a VIN may support only one credit. Required for each opened vehicle. No answer means the credit remains Incomplete.

Fact.Name: Additional new vehicle tentative credit from seller's report (Schedule A line 9)
Fact.Description: Transcribe this vehicle's line 9 amount from its seller report. Required for each opened item; the derived amount caps it at $7,500 for this VIN before the per-vehicle amounts are added.

Fact.Name: Additional new vehicle credit transferred to the dealer (Schedule A line 4a)
Fact.Description: If this additional vehicle's credit was transferred to the dealer, enter the seller-report amount; enter 0 if it was not transferred. This answer is required for every opened item so an unanswered transfer question cannot be mistaken for a no-transfer sale. A positive transfer excludes the vehicle from Schedule 3 line 6f.

Fact.Name: Prior-year (2024) modified AGI for the clean vehicle MAGI test (Form 8936 lines 3-4)
Fact.Description: The taxpayer's 2024 modified adjusted gross income (Form 8936 line 3a = line 11 of the 2024 Form 1040; the §911/Form 2555/Form 4563 add-backs are added separately, by /cleanVehiclePriorYearMagi), used as the prior-year prong of the "MAGI exceeds the limit for BOTH 2024 and 2025" disqualification test. A SAFE-HARBOR input: the single-year fact graph cannot derive a prior-year amount, so the taxpayer supplies it to prove the lookback qualified them. Integer cents; Min 0. Optional — when unanswered the disqualification test conservatively assumes the prior year also exceeded the limit (an unknown 2024 MAGI does not rescue a filer from repayment — World-#1-safe for an addition to tax).

Fact.Name: New clean vehicle: otherwise no longer qualifies (Schedule A (Form 8936) 8a/8e)
Fact.Description: True if the taxpayer no longer qualifies for the NEW clean vehicle credit for a reason other than the MAGI limitation — e.g. the vehicle was resold within 30 days of the placed-in-service date (Schedule A line 8a), or it was not acquired for use or lease (line 8e). When true and a new credit was transferred, the full transferred amount is repaid on Schedule 2 line 1b regardless of MAGI. Optional — absent => treated as false (not disqualified on a categorical ground); the MAGI test still applies.

Fact.Name: Used clean vehicle: otherwise no longer qualifies (Schedule A (Form 8936) 13a/13d/13e/13g)
Fact.Description: True if the taxpayer no longer qualifies for the PREVIOUSLY-OWNED clean vehicle credit for a reason other than the MAGI limitation — e.g. resold within 30 days (Schedule A line 13a), already claimed a used-EV credit in the 3-year lookback (13d), sales price over $25,000 (13e), or claimable as a dependent (13g). When true and a used credit was transferred, the full transferred amount is repaid on Schedule 2 line 1c regardless of MAGI. Optional — absent => treated as false.

Fact.Name: New transferred clean vehicle credit, zero when unanswered for branch comparisons
Fact.Description: Complete-safe comparison view of the optional new clean vehicle transfer amount. An unanswered transfer remains the existing no-transfer path; an answered amount is floored at zero under the writable's Min rule.

Fact.Name: New clean vehicle categorical disqualification, false when unanswered
Fact.Description: Complete-safe Boolean view for the optional repayment attestation. Silence keeps the existing repayment interpretation that no categorical disqualification was answered.

Fact.Name: Previously-owned clean vehicle categorical disqualification, false when unanswered
Fact.Description: Complete-safe Boolean view for the optional used-vehicle repayment attestation. Silence keeps the existing repayment interpretation that no categorical disqualification was answered.

Fact.Name: New clean vehicle qualification attestation, false when unanswered
Fact.Description: Complete-safe Boolean view of the affirmative new-vehicle qualification intake. An unanswered attestation remains the existing no-credit branch.

Fact.Name: Previously-owned clean vehicle qualification attestation, false when unanswered
Fact.Description: Complete-safe Boolean view of the affirmative used-vehicle qualification intake. An unanswered attestation remains the existing no-credit branch.

Fact.Name: Previously-owned clean vehicle sale price, zero when unanswered for comparisons
Fact.Description: Complete-safe comparison view of the optional used-vehicle sale price. An unanswered price remains the existing no-credit path; an answered amount is floored at zero under the writable's Min rule.

Fact.Name: Clean vehicle type attestation, false when unanswered
Fact.Description: Complete-safe Boolean view of the Schedule A new-vehicle routing attestation. Silence follows the existing fallthrough to the previously-owned vehicle arm.

Fact.Name: Current-year (2025) modified AGI for the clean vehicle MAGI test (Form 8936 line 2)
Fact.Description:
Form 8936 line 2 MAGI for 2025 = /agi PLUS the Form 8936 lines 1b-1e add-backs — the Puerto Rico section 933 exclusion, Form 2555 lines 45/50, and Form 4563 line 15 — as the Derived below shows.
Both possession intakes are complete-safe with a $0 tail, so a filer who is never asked reaches this fact with every add-back at $0 and MAGI equal to AGI — which for THIS fact means a repayment near a threshold can still go undetected. That is a faithful-input limitation, not a derivation gap; wiring cannot close it, only asking can.
This fact is a direct alias of ctcOdc /modifiedAgiWithForeignAndPossessionExclusions, the single root for the AGI + sections 911/931/933 modified AGI that this and four sibling surfaces define identically; the add-back list this description reads from the printed form is unchanged and lives on the root.
For example, $20,000 of section 933 exclusion against $259,190 of AGI gives $279,190 here.

Fact.Name: New clean vehicle credit MAGI limit by filing status (Form 8936 line 5 chart, §30D)
Fact.Description: The IRC §30D(f)(10) modified-AGI limitation for the NEW clean vehicle credit (Form 8936 line-5 chart): $300,000 MFJ or QSS, $225,000 head of household, $150,000 single or MFS. A filer is disqualified only if MAGI exceeds this for BOTH 2024 and 2025.

Fact.Name: Previously-owned clean vehicle credit MAGI limit by filing status (Form 8936 line 5 chart, §25E)
Fact.Description: The IRC §25E(b)(2) modified-AGI limitation for the PREVIOUSLY-OWNED clean vehicle credit (Form 8936 line-5 chart): $150,000 MFJ or QSS, $112,500 head of household, $75,000 single or MFS. A filer is disqualified only if MAGI exceeds this for BOTH 2024 and 2025.

Fact.Name: Form 8936 line 4, the prior year (2024) modified AGI total
Fact.Description:
Form 8936 line 4, printed "Add lines 3a through 3e" - the prior year prong of the both years MAGI test, read in place of the bare safe harbor amount by /newCleanVehicleMagiAllowsCredit, /usedCleanVehicleMagiAllowsCredit, /newCleanVehicleCreditRepayment and /usedCleanVehicleCreditRepayment.
THE BASE TERM IS DELIBERATELY UNGUARDED. /writableCleanVehiclePriorYearMagi is a safe harbor input whose own INCOMPLETENESS is load bearing: the four readers each carry Not(IsComplete(...)) as the "unanswered means the prior year also exceeded the limit" arm, which is the World-#1-safe reading for an addition to tax. Guarding it here would make this total Complete on every return and silently delete that arm. The FOUR ADD BACKS are guarded instead, so this fact is Complete exactly when the base writable is Complete and Incomplete exactly when it is not - the completeness the readers test is unchanged, term for term.
VALUE-NEUTRAL on every return that answers no add back, which is the whole committed corpus: each guarded term is a hard $0 there, so this total equals /writableCleanVehiclePriorYearMagi exactly.

Fact.Name: Form 8936 line 5 chart row for the PRIOR year (2024) filing status - the Part II/III limits column
Fact.Description:
The line 5 chart threshold the 2024 prong of the both years MAGI test measures against, /newCleanVehicleMagiThreshold answers the same chart for THIS year, off filingStatus:/isFilingStatusMFJ, /isFilingStatusQSS and /isFilingStatusHOH - the 2025 election. That is the wrong chart row for anyone who married, divorced or was widowed during the year, which is precisely the population the prior year prong exists for.
FALLBACK, NOT A NEW REFUSAL: /writableCleanVehiclePriorYearFilingStatusCode is an optional printed intake, so when it is unanswered this fact resolves to /newCleanVehicleMagiThreshold - exactly today's behaviour - and no return that has never seen the line 5 code question changes value. The five codes are the ones the chart prints: S, MFS, HOH, MFJ, QSS.

Fact.Name: Form 8936 line 5 chart row for the PRIOR year (2024) filing status - the Part IV limits column
Fact.Description:
The line 5 chart threshold the 2024 prong of the both years MAGI test measures against, /usedCleanVehicleMagiThreshold answers the same chart for THIS year, off filingStatus:/isFilingStatusMFJ, /isFilingStatusQSS and /isFilingStatusHOH - the 2025 election. That is the wrong chart row for anyone who married, divorced or was widowed during the year, which is precisely the population the prior year prong exists for.
FALLBACK, NOT A NEW REFUSAL: /writableCleanVehiclePriorYearFilingStatusCode is an optional printed intake, so when it is unanswered this fact resolves to /usedCleanVehicleMagiThreshold - exactly today's behaviour - and no return that has never seen the line 5 code question changes value. The five codes are the ones the chart prints: S, MFS, HOH, MFJ, QSS.

Fact.Name: The Schedule A line 3 placed-in-service date falls outside 2025
Fact.Description: TRUE when the Schedule A (Form 8936) line 3 date (/writableCleanVehiclePlacedInServiceDate) is answered and falls before January 1, 2025 or after December 31, 2025. The repayment of a transferred credit is an addition to the tax of the year the vehicle was placed in service, so a transfer for a vehicle placed in service in another year is not repaid on this return. FALSE when the date is unanswered or inside 2025. Always complete.

Fact.Name: Repayment of transferred new clean vehicle credit (Schedule 2 line 1b)
Fact.Description: Schedule 2 (Form 1040) line 1b = the full amount of the transferred NEW clean vehicle credit, repaid when the taxpayer no longer qualifies. Branch-gated on IsComplete(the transferred amount): a return with no transferred new credit takes the else-0 branch without evaluating the MAGI chain. When a transfer exists, the repayment is the transferred amount if the taxpayer is disqualified — either the categorical attestation is true, OR the MAGI test fails (2025 MAGI > the §30D limit AND (2024 MAGI unanswered OR 2024 MAGI > the limit)) — else 0 (the filer still qualifies and keeps the point-of-sale credit).

Fact.Name: Repayment of transferred previously-owned clean vehicle credit (Schedule 2 line 1c)
Fact.Description: Schedule 2 (Form 1040) line 1c = the full amount of the transferred PREVIOUSLY-OWNED clean vehicle credit, repaid when the taxpayer no longer qualifies. Same shape as line 1b: branch- gated on IsComplete(the transferred used amount); when a transfer exists, the repayment is the transferred amount if the used categorical attestation is true OR the §25E MAGI test fails (2025 MAGI > the §25E limit AND (2024 MAGI unanswered OR 2024 MAGI > the limit)) — else 0.

Fact.Name: Previously-owned clean vehicle sales price (Schedule A (Form 8936) line 14)
Fact.Description:
The sales price of the previously-owned clean vehicle — Schedule A (Form 8936) line 14, the base of the 30% credit on line 15. Integer cents; Min 0. Optional — absent means no previously-owned clean vehicle credit is claimed, and /usedCleanVehicleCredit takes its else-0 branch without evaluating anything else.
THE $25,000 CEILING IS COMPUTED FROM THIS FACT, NOT ATTESTED. Schedule A line 13e ("Is the sales price of the vehicle more than $25,000? Yes. Stop here. The vehicle doesn't qualify for the Part IV credit") reads the same figure this line reads, so asking the taxpayer a second time would let the two answers disagree. tests/nodes/ty2025/form8936/ cvc-used-credit-price-at-25000-allows and -price-over-25000-denies are the boundary pair.

Fact.Name: Previously-owned clean vehicle: the taxpayer affirms every non-computable Part IV gate
Fact.Description:
TRUE only if the taxpayer affirms ALL of the Schedule A Part IV qualification gates this dictionary cannot derive: line 6 (the VIN belongs to a previously owned clean vehicle acquired after 2022 AND BEFORE OCTOBER 1, 2025 — the OBBBA termination date — and placed in service during the tax year), line 13a (not resold within 30 days of the placed-in-service date), line 13d (no previously-owned clean vehicle credit claimed for another vehicle in the 3-year lookback), line 13f (acquired for use and not for resale, and not leased from another person), and line 13g (the taxpayer cannot be claimed as a dependent on another return).
TWO SUBSECTION (f) CONDITIONS ARE ALSO AFFIRMED HERE: the taxpayer uses the vehicle primarily in the United States (IRC 30D(f)(4), applied to this credit by IRC 25E(e); the 2025 Instructions for Form 8936 list it among the additional requirements that must be met to qualify for the credit), and no previously owned clean vehicle credit has already been allowed for this VIN (IRC 30D(f)(8), one credit per vehicle, determined by VIN). Neither can be computed on the return; a filer who cannot affirm either answers No.
UNANSWERED MEANS NO CREDIT, AND THAT IS THE POINT. This is the mirror image of /writableUsedCleanVehicleOtherwiseIneligible, which serves the REPAYMENT direction and is shaped so silence assumes the filer is NOT disqualified (safe for an addition to tax). Re-using that fact here, inverted, would GRANT a credit on silence — the false-allowance this unit exists not to create. A credit needs an affirmative answer; an addition to tax does not.
Line 13e (sales price over $25,000) is deliberately NOT in this list: it is computed from /writableUsedCleanVehicleSalePrice. Line 13b/13c (the MAGI test) is computed too, by /usedCleanVehicleMagiAllowsCredit.

Fact.Name: New clean vehicle tentative credit amount from the seller's report (Schedule A (Form 8936) line 9)
Fact.Description:
Schedule A (Form 8936) line 9, the tentative credit amount for the new clean vehicle. The instructions make this an INPUT rather than a computation: "Tentative credit amounts for new clean vehicles are provided to the purchaser by the seller at the time the vehicle is sold, and later forwarded to the IRS. Generally, this amount will be the maximum credit amount listed in the seller's report for the vehicle." Nothing on the return determines it — the §30D(b) critical-minerals and battery-components halves are certified by the seller — so the taxpayer transcribes it. Integer cents; Min 0. Optional — absent means no new clean vehicle credit is claimed.
THE $7,500 CEILING IS A STATUTE, NOT A FORM LINE, and the statute is already vendored: IRC 30D(b) — "(b) Per vehicle dollar limitation", whose paragraph (1) makes the per-vehicle amount "the sum of the amounts determined under paragraphs (2) and (3)", and those two paragraphs each print $3,750. $7,500 per vehicle, citable today from 26 U.S.C. 30D, https://uscode.house.gov/view.xhtml?req=granuleid:USC-2024-title26-section30D&num=0&edition=2024, so invariant #3 does not stand in the way. An unbounded intake would produce an unbounded nonrefundable credit up to the filer's tax; the used side takes its printed $4,000 ceiling and this side has no reason not to take its statutory one.
THE CAP IS APPLIED IN TWO PLACES, deliberately, and they are not redundant. This writable carries a Max limit of $7,500, which is the INTAKE constraint — a transcription that exceeds the statutory per-vehicle maximum is not a number Form 8936 can carry. /newCleanVehicleCredit additionally takes a LesserOf against the same figure, which is the COMPUTATION, so the limitation is visible in the credit's own body rather than resting on an intake rule a fixture or an API caller could bypass. tests/nodes/ty2025/form8936/ cvc-new-credit-tentative-above-30d-cap-binds is the boundary case: 50,000 in, 7,500 out.
WHAT IS STILL NOT CHECKED, and named rather than implied: nothing here verifies that a seller's report BELOW $7,500 is right. §30D(b)(2) and (3) each condition their $3,750 on a requirement (critical minerals, battery components) that only the seller certifies, so a vehicle qualifying for one half and not the other is $3,750 and this dictionary takes the filer's transcription for it. The cap bounds the error above; it cannot detect one below.

Fact.Name: Schedule A (Form 8936) line 10, the business or investment use percentage of the new clean vehicle
Fact.Description:
Schedule A (Form 8936) line 10, printed "Business/investment use percentage (see instructions)" with the percent sign preprinted beside the box, so this is a WHOLE NUMBER of percent (Int, 0 to 100) and not a rate. It is the legacy single vehicle (scalar) path's copy of that box; the Schedule A copy collection has its own, form8936sa /form8936Vehicles/*/writableBoxf220, and the application must not ask both for one vehicle.
WHAT IT IS: the 2025 Instructions for Form 8936, Line 10 figure the taxpayer computes by "dividing the number of miles the vehicle was driven during the year for business purposes or for the production of income (not to include any commuting mileage) by the total number of miles the vehicle was driven for all purposes", with the employee use rule (100 percent where the personal use value is in the employees' wages) and the mid year conversion proration in the same instruction. The graph cannot derive any of that: no mileage fact exists in this dictionary.
OPTIONAL, AND UNANSWERED MEANS WHOLLY PERSONAL. Leaving it blank is the same answer as 0, which is the state every committed return is in, so opening this question changes no existing result. Answering it splits the credit: line 11 (this percentage times the capped line 9) becomes a general business credit on Form 3800 Part III line 1y, and line 12 (line 9 minus line 11) stays the personal credit on Schedule 3 line 6f. 100 percent leaves nothing on Schedule 3 line 6f, which is what the printed line 11 routing says: "entered 100% on line 10, stop here. Otherwise, go to Part III below" (https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-pdf/f8936sa.pdf, page 2).
IT IS NOT the Form 4562 column (c) percentage, which is a different vehicle's box in a different computation; nothing here reads or writes form4562 /form4562ListedProperties/*/writableBusinessUsePercentage.

Fact.Name: New clean vehicle: the taxpayer affirms every non-computable Part II/III gate
Fact.Description:
TRUE only if the taxpayer affirms ALL of the Schedule A Part II gates this dictionary cannot derive: line 5 (the VIN belongs to a new clean vehicle ACQUIRED BEFORE OCTOBER 1, 2025 — the OBBBA termination date — and placed in service during the tax year), line 8a (not resold within 30 days of the placed-in-service date), and line 8e (acquired for use or to lease to others, and not for resale, and not leased from another person).
TWO SUBSECTION (f) CONDITIONS ARE ALSO AFFIRMED HERE: the taxpayer uses the vehicle primarily in the United States (IRC 30D(f)(4); the 2025 Instructions for Form 8936 list it among the additional requirements that must be met to qualify for the credit), and no clean vehicle credit has already been allowed for this VIN (IRC 30D(f)(8), one credit per vehicle, determined by VIN). Neither can be computed on the return; a filer who cannot affirm either answers No.
form3800 /form3800PartIiiLine1yCredit reads this module's Schedule A line 11 (/newCleanVehicleBusinessUsePartOfCredit) and carries it to Schedule 3 line 6a. Line 10 is an optional intake, /writableNewCleanVehicleBusinessUsePercentage, and the credit SPLITS as IRC 30D(c)(1) and (c)(2) say it does - the depreciable share to the general business credit, the rest to Schedule 3 line 6f. A filer who leaves line 10 blank is at 0 percent, wholly personal.
UNANSWERED MEANS NO CREDIT — see /writableUsedCleanVehicleQualifiesForCredit for why a credit needs an affirmative answer while a repayment does not.

Fact.Name: Previously-owned clean vehicle credit: the MAGI both-years test allows the credit (Schedule A lines 13b/13c)
Fact.Description:
TRUE unless MAGI exceeds the §25E limit for BOTH 2024 and 2025 — the printed rule on Form 8936 line 31, routed by Schedule A lines 13b and 13c: if 2025 MAGI is not more than the limit you skip 13c entirely and go on, and only a filer over the limit in 2025 is asked about 2024.
UNANSWERED 2024 MAGI DENIES, and the direction is deliberate on BOTH sides of this module. /writableCleanVehiclePriorYearMagi is a safe-harbor input the single-year graph cannot derive; the repayment facts read silence as "the prior year also exceeded" so that an unknown lookback never rescues a filer from an addition to tax. The same reading here means an unknown lookback never buys a credit. One convention, conservative in both directions, rather than two readings of one fact.

Fact.Name: New clean vehicle credit: the MAGI both-years test allows the credit (Schedule A lines 8c/8d)
Fact.Description: The §30D twin of /usedCleanVehicleMagiAllowsCredit, measured against the "Part II/III Limits" column of the same chart and routed by Schedule A lines 8c/8d instead of 13b/13c. Same both-years rule, same unanswered-denies reading.

Fact.Name: This additional vehicle meets the §30D acquisition cutoff and 2025 placed-in-service year
Fact.Description: Schedule A line 5's per-vehicle timing gate: the acquisition date is no later than September 30, 2025, and the placed-in-service date falls in 2025. The acquisition date is the binding-contract-plus-payment date defined in the Form 8936 instructions. Each input is required; this derived Boolean is read only after the candidate checks both dates are complete. September 30 is included and October 1 is excluded.

Fact.Name: This additional new vehicle has a valid VIN used for one credit only
Fact.Description: The additional vehicle's VIN must be exactly 17 valid uppercase VIN characters, appear once across the additional-new-vehicle records, and differ from the primary Schedule A VIN when that VIN is answered. When a legacy clean-vehicle amount or transfer is entered, the primary Schedule A VIN is required before an additional vehicle can be claimed. A malformed or duplicate VIN leaves this item's candidate Incomplete; it is never silently treated as a zero-credit vehicle.

Fact.Name: Additional new vehicle's capped personal-use credit before the taxpayer-level tax limit
Fact.Description: The amount this distinct additional new vehicle contributes to Form 8936 line 9: zero unless its VIN and required dates are answered, its non-computable personal-credit attestation is Yes, its acquisition/service dates qualify, it passes the shared §30D MAGI test, and it was not transferred to the dealer. Otherwise the contribution is the lesser of that vehicle's seller-reported Schedule A line 9 amount or the §30D $7,500 per-vehicle cap. Required item omissions remain Incomplete. A positive transfer is not also claimed at line 6f. The candidate does not apply the taxpayer's §26 tax limit; the aggregate does that once after all per-vehicle caps are summed.

Fact.Name: Sum of additional new-vehicle per-VIN candidates before the Form 8936 tax limit
Fact.Description: Complete-safe zero when the additional-new-vehicle collection is unanswered or empty. Once the collection is opened, every vehicle candidate must resolve; one incomplete vehicle leaves the aggregate incomplete rather than dropping that vehicle. Each candidate has already applied its own $7,500 statutory cap.

Fact.Name: The Schedule A line 2 VIN is on the return (condition of the legacy clean vehicle credits)
Fact.Description: $0 when the Schedule A (Form 8936) line 2 VIN (/writableCleanVehicleVin) is answered, and Incomplete when it is not. Added to the computed amount of /newCleanVehiclePrimaryCreditBeforeTaxLimit and /usedCleanVehicleTentativeCreditAmount, so a return that claims either credit without a VIN is disclosed as unfinished instead of computing a credit the law does not allow. A transfer-only return (no credit claimed) never reaches it, and the repayment of a transferred credit does not read it.

Fact.Name: Legacy root new vehicle's personal-use credit before the taxpayer-level tax limit
Fact.Description:
The legacy root writables continue to model at most one new vehicle, with that vehicle's statutory $7,500 cap applied before it is added to the collection of additional per-VIN amounts. Kept separate so old single-vehicle inputs and expected results remain unchanged.
THIS IS SCHEDULE A LINE 12, THE PERSONAL HALF, AND IT SUBTRACTS LINE 11. The capped line 9 less /newCleanVehicleBusinessUsePartOfCredit is exactly the printed "Subtract line 11 from line 9 in Part II", and it foots with the business half against the same capped base, so the two cannot claim the same dollar twice. Every gate in this arm's When is also a gate of line 11, so the subtrahend resolves wherever this arm is taken, and on a return that never answers the new line 10 intake the subtrahend is $0 and this fact is the number it has always been.

Fact.Name: New clean vehicle personal-use credits before the Form 8936 line 12 tax limit
Fact.Description: The sum of the capped legacy root vehicle candidate and every additional vehicle's individually capped candidate. This is the aggregate Schedule A line 12 amount that Form 8936 line 9 carries into the shared taxpayer-level line 12 tax limit.

Fact.Name: Previously-owned clean vehicle credit amount before the tax-liability limit (Schedule A (Form 8936) line 17)
Fact.Description:
Schedule A (Form 8936) line 17 = the smaller of line 15 (30% of the sales price) and line 16 (the printed $4,000 maximum vehicle credit amount), and 0 unless every Part IV gate is satisfied: the affirmative attestation, the MAGI both-years test, and the printed line-13e ceiling that the sales price is not more than $25,000.
THE $25,000 TEST IS "MORE THAN", NOT "AT LEAST" — a vehicle sold for exactly $25,000 qualifies, and tests/nodes/ty2025/form8936/cvc-used-credit-price-at-25000-allows and -price-over-25000-denies are the pair that pins it.
Whole-dollar HALF_UP rounding on the 30% product (this dictionary's standard rounding convention); the $4,000 cap is exact.

Fact.Name: Personal credits ahead of the previously-owned clean vehicle credit (Form 8936 line 16)
Fact.Description:
Form 8936 line 16, whose instruction is "Enter the total, if any, credits from Schedule 3 (Form 1040), lines 1 through 4, 5b, 6d, and 6I" — seven terms: the foreign tax credit (line 1), the child and dependent care credit (line 2), the nonrefundable education credits (line 3), the retirement savings contributions credit (line 4), the energy efficient home improvement credit (line 5b), the credit for the elderly or the disabled (line 6d), and the Form 8978 line-14 amount (line 6l, printed "6I" in the extraction).
NOTHING ELSE IS ON THE LIST, and the omissions are what make this acyclic: no CTC, no 5a, no 6c, no 6f, no 6g, no 6h. Each of those is figured AFTER this credit and subtracts 6m in its own limit worksheet (ctcOdc Credit Limit Worksheet A line 2 names 6f and 6m by name). Non-circular, checked rather than assumed: none of the seven terms depends on /sched3Line6f or /sched3Line6m (their only consumers are Schedule 3 line 7, the ctcOdc Worksheet A line-2 sum, and the Form 5695 Part I / 8396 / 8839 limit worksheets, none of which is upstream of a term here).

Fact.Name: Tax liability limit for the previously-owned clean vehicle credit (Form 8936 line 17)
Fact.Description: Form 8936 line 17 = line 15 (Form 1040 line 18, taxCalculations /totalTentativeTax) minus line 16 (/form8936CreditsOrderedBeforeUsedCredit), floored at 0: "Subtract line 16 from line 15. If zero or less, enter -0- and stop here. You can't claim the Part IV credit."

Fact.Name: Credit for previously owned clean vehicles (Form 8936 line 18 → Schedule 3 line 6m)
Fact.Description:
Form 8936 line 18 = the smaller of line 14 (the Schedule A Part IV credit amount, /usedCleanVehicleTentativeCreditAmount) and line 17 (the tax liability limit), "here and on Schedule 3 (Form 1040), line 6m". Nonrefundable and NOT carried forward — "If you cannot use part of the credit because of the tax liability limit, the unused credit is lost. The unused credit cannot be carried back or forward to other tax years" — which is why the LesserOf is the whole of the rule and no carryforward fact exists.
NOT CLAIMABLE ON A TRANSFERRED CREDIT. Schedule A line 13b routes a filer who transferred the credit to the dealer away from line 13d and out of Part IV ("If you transferred the credit amount to the dealer at the time of sale, stop here and see instructions"); that filer's money already came off the purchase price and this module's /usedCleanVehicleCreditRepayment owns their return. AN ANSWERED ZERO IS NOT A TRANSFER: the gate denies only on an ANSWERED POSITIVE transfer. tests/nodes/ty2025/form8936/cvc-new-credit-transferred-not-claimed-again pins the positive case on the new-side twin and tests/nodes/ty2025/form8936/cvc-new-credit-transfer-answered-zero-still-claims pins the zero.
COMPLETE-SAFE by branch gate: with no sales price answered the else-0 branch is taken without evaluating the limit chain (a branch-gate pattern used elsewhere in this dictionary), so every committed scenario keeps /sched3Line6m at Complete 0.00.

Fact.Name: Personal credits ahead of the new clean vehicle credit (Form 8936 line 11)
Fact.Description:
Form 8936 line 11, whose instruction is "Enter the total, if any, credits from Schedule 3 (Form 1040), lines 1 through 4, 5b, 6d, 6I, and 6m" — the line-16 list PLUS the previously-owned clean vehicle credit at line 6m. That single extra term is the printed proof that 6m is figured BEFORE 6f, and it is what tests/nodes/ty2025/form8936/cvc-used-credit-ordered-ahead-of-new-credit exercises: on a return whose tax capacity is smaller than the two credits together, the used credit takes it and the new credit gets what is left.
The 6m term reads /usedCleanVehicleCredit directly rather than schedule3:/sched3Line6m, which is that fact's only body — the same number, one hop shorter, and it keeps the ordering inside the module that owns it.

Fact.Name: Tax liability limit for the personal-use part of the new clean vehicle credit (Form 8936 line 12)
Fact.Description: Form 8936 line 12 = line 10 (Form 1040 line 18, taxCalculations /totalTentativeTax) minus line 11 (/form8936CreditsOrderedBeforeNewCredit), floored at 0: "Subtract line 11 from line 10. If zero or less, enter -0- and stop here. You can't claim the personal use part of the credit."

Fact.Name: Clean vehicle credit, personal use part (Form 8936 line 13 → Schedule 3 line 6f)
Fact.Description:
Form 8936 line 13 = the smaller of line 9 (the total personal-use amount for the new vehicles) and line 12 (the taxpayer-level tax-liability limit), "here and on Schedule 3 (Form 1040), line 6f". The candidate sum keeps the legacy root input as one vehicle and adds every additional vehicle's Schedule A line-12 amount by its own VIN. Each vehicle's §30D(b) $7,500 cap is applied before the sum; the line-12 liability limit is applied ONCE to that aggregate, after the used credit at line 6m has consumed its printed priority. Nonrefundable and NOT carried forward — any unused personal-use credit is lost.
This direct Schedule 3 path carries the PERSONAL half, which is what Schedule A line 12 is: the legacy root vehicle's candidate SUBTRACTS its Schedule A line 11 business/investment share, and that share goes to Form 3800 Part III line 1y rather than being denied. A vehicle on the /additionalNewCleanVehicles collection is still wholly personal - that collection has no line 10 of its own. A positive dealer transfer excludes that vehicle; an answered $0 transfer still qualifies because only a positive transfer is a transfer. The multi-vehicle new-credit collection requires VIN, dates, the seller amount and an affirmative qualification answer on every opened item. Dates are checked per vehicle: acquisition on 2025-09-30 qualifies and 2025-10-01 does not. If an opened record is incomplete, this total stays Incomplete rather than silently dropping the vehicle. An unanswered or empty collection adds a complete-safe $0 and preserves the legacy single-vehicle route.

Fact.Name: Total transferred clean vehicle credit repaid (Schedule 2 lines 1b + 1c)
Fact.Description: The sum of the new (line 1b) and previously-owned (line 1c) clean vehicle credit repayments — the amount this unit adds to Schedule 2 line 1z. Complete-safe 0 on any return with no transferred credit.

Fact.Name: The credit was not transferred to the dealer at the time of sale (line 4a, No)
Fact.Description: The No box of Schedule A (Form 8936) line 4a: the negation of /cleanVehicleCreditTransferredToDealer, which the printed form routes on to line 5.

Fact.Name: The credit was transferred to the dealer at the time of sale (line 4a, Yes)
Fact.Description: The Yes box of Schedule A (Form 8936) line 4a: a transfer exists for this vehicle, which the graph reads as a positive line 4a amount. An ANSWERED ZERO IS NOT A TRANSFER, the same reading /newCleanVehicleCredit already applies to the transfer writables: a filer who answers $0.00 at the transfer question transferred nothing.

Fact.Name: Form 8936 line 1a, the 2025 adjusted gross income the clean vehicle MAGI starts from
Fact.Description: Form 8936 line 1a, printed “Enter the amount from line 11a of your 2025 Form 1040, 1040-SR, or 1040-NR” — the first term of the Part I MAGI addition. It is taxCalculations:/agi, the very fact this module's /cleanVehicleCurrentYearMagi already rounds as the first term of line 2, and the same fact IRS1040 prints at line 11a (f1_75[0]) and line 11b (f2_01[0]). /agi is whole dollar in the manifest, so the alias and the Round inside line 2 print the identical figure and the printed column foots. PRINT ONLY: line 2 already consumes /agi, so nothing new needs to read this fact; it exists to give the printed 1a cell a fact of its own instead of leaving it blank on a filed form.

Fact.Name: No filer on the return can be claimed as a dependent (Schedule A (Form 8936) line 13g, No box)
Fact.Description: The No box of Schedule A (Form 8936) line 13g, "Can you be claimed as a dependent on another person's tax return, such as your parent's return?". The Yes box is the shipping fact filers:/eitherFilerCanBeClaimed, so this No box is its negation and no second attestation is collected. Taken across the return: on a joint return either spouse being claimable bars the previously owned clean vehicle credit, which is the conservative reading of IRC 25E(c)(3)(C). WHEN /eitherFilerCanBeClaimed IS INCOMPLETE, BOTH BOXES STAY BLANK. That happens when the return has a secondary filer whose canBeClaimed answer is not yet given; the schedule then prints neither box, which is the honest rendering of an unanswered question rather than a guessed No.

Fact.Name: The VIN on line 2 does not belong to a new clean vehicle (Schedule A (Form 8936) line 5, No)
Fact.Description: The No box of Schedule A (Form 8936) line 5: the negation of /writableCleanVehicleIsNewCleanVehicle, which the printed form routes on to line 6.

Fact.Name: The VIN on line 2 does not belong to a previously owned clean vehicle (line 6, No)
Fact.Description: The No box of Schedule A (Form 8936) line 6: the negation of /writableCleanVehicleIsPreviouslyOwnedCleanVehicle, which the printed form routes on to line 7.

Fact.Name: The VIN on line 2 does not belong to a qualified commercial clean vehicle (line 7, No)
Fact.Description: The No box of Schedule A (Form 8936) line 7: the negation of /writableCleanVehicleIsQualifiedCommercial. The printed form stops the schedule here, because a vehicle described on none of lines 5, 6 and 7 has no credit amount to figure.

Fact.Name: Form 8936 line 1c, the Form 2555 line 45 exclusion added back to 2025 MAGI
Fact.Description: Form 8936 line 1c, printed “Enter any amount from Form 2555, line 45”. Line 2 consumes the PAIR of Form 2555 lines 45 and 50 through ctcOdc:/sched8812Line2bForm2555Exclusions, which is form2555 /form2555Lines45And50ForeignEarnedIncomeTaxWorksheetLine2a gated on form2555 /filesForm2555ForeignEarnedIncomeExclusion and $0 otherwise. Form 8936 prints the two amounts on separate rows, so this fact splits that pair back into its line 45 half and REPEATS THE SAME GATE deliberately: an ungated read would print an add back on a return whose AGI never carried the exclusion out, and 1c + 1d would then not foot to the line 2 total. Signed, with no floor, exactly as form2555 /form2555Line45ExclusionsNetOfAllocableDeductions is: line 45 prints no “if zero or less” instruction and a line 44 larger than line 43 carries a negative. PRINT ONLY. This fact is a direct alias of schedule1A:/schedule1ALine2bForm2555Line45Exclusions (Schedule 1-A line 2b, the same gated Form 2555 line 45 amount), which already computes the identical quantity.

Fact.Name: Form 8936 line 1d, the Form 2555 line 50 housing deduction added back to 2025 MAGI
Fact.Description: Form 8936 line 1d, printed “Enter any amount from Form 2555, line 50” — the housing DEDUCTION half of the pair line 2 consumes through ctcOdc:/sched8812Line2bForm2555Exclusions. Same gate as its line 45 twin and for the same reason: the two halves must foot to the single line 2 term. form2555 /form2555Line50HousingDeduction is itself complete safe ($0 when unanswered), so this fact resolves on every return. PRINT ONLY. This fact is a direct alias of schedule1A:/schedule1ALine2cForm2555Line50HousingDeduction (Schedule 1-A line 2c, the same gated Form 2555 line 50 amount), which already computes the identical quantity.

Fact.Name: Form 8936 line 1e, the Form 4563 line 15 possession exclusion added back to 2025 MAGI
Fact.Description: Form 8936 line 1e, printed “Enter any amount from Form 4563, line 15” — the section 931 American Samoa add back term of the Part I MAGI addition. It is ctcOdc:/possessionIncomeExclusion931, the fourth term of this module's /cleanVehicleCurrentYearMagi (line 2), derived and complete safe. PRINT ONLY: line 2 already consumes the same fact.

Fact.Name: Form 8936 line 1b, the excluded Puerto Rico income added back to 2025 MAGI
Fact.Description: Form 8936 line 1b, printed “Enter any income from Puerto Rico you excluded” — the section 933 add back term of the Part I MAGI addition. It is ctcOdc:/puertoRicoIncomeExclusion933, the second term of this module's /cleanVehicleCurrentYearMagi (line 2). That fact is derived and complete safe ($0 when the filer is never asked), so this alias is complete on every return. PRINT ONLY: line 2 already consumes the same fact.

Fact.Name: The vehicle was not resold within 30 days of the placed in service date (8a and 13a, No)
Fact.Description: The No box of Schedule A (Form 8936) lines 8a and 13a: the negation of /writableCleanVehicleResoldWithin30Days, which the printed form routes on to line 8b or line 13b.

Fact.Name: The transferred clean vehicle credit must be repaid (Schedule A (Form 8936) line 4b)
Fact.Description: The line 4b box, which a filer who transferred the credit checks when line 8a, 8d, 13a or 13c directs them to: the transferred amount is no longer allowed and is repaid on Schedule 2 (Form 1040) line 1b or 1c. The graph already computes exactly that outcome, so the box reads /totalCleanVehicleCreditRepayment rather than re asking. BROADER THAN THE FOUR PRINTED REFERENCES, and named rather than hidden: the repayment facts are disqualified by the collapsed categorical attestations, which fold in lines 8e, 13d, 13e and 13g as well as the resale and MAGI grounds the four references name. Every ground that fires here is a ground the printed schedule also stops on, and a filer stopped on one of them who transferred the credit does owe the repayment; the box is checked on the graph's own answer to the question line 4b asks.

Fact.Name: Form 8936 lines 10 and 15, the Form 1040 line 18 tax the clean vehicle credits are limited by
Fact.Description: Form 8936 lines 10 and 15, both printed “Enter the amount from Form 1040, 1040-SR, or 1040-NR, line 18” — one row in Part III for the new clean vehicle credit, one in Part IV for the previously owned credit, and the SAME figure on both: taxCalculations:/totalTentativeTax, which IRS1040 prints at line 18 (f2_10[0]). This module already reads that fact twice: /newCleanVehicleCreditTaxLiabilityLimit (line 12) and /usedCleanVehicleCreditTaxLiabilityLimit (line 17) each subtract their ordering sum from it. One alias serves both printed cells, exactly as IRS1040 maps /agi to both its line 11a and line 11b boxes. PRINT ONLY: the two limit facts already consume /totalTentativeTax.

Fact.Name: Business or investment use part of the new clean vehicle credit (line 11)
Fact.Description:
Schedule A (Form 8936) line 11, the capped line 9 tentative credit multiplied by the line 10 business and investment use percentage, which the printed form routes to Form 8936 Part II line 6, then line 8, then Form 3800, Part III, line 1y. form3800 /form3800PartIiiLine1yCredit takes this fact as its first addend whenever the Schedule A copy collection is absent. IRC 30D(c)(1) and (c)(2) SPLIT the credit between the section 38(b) business credit and the subpart A personal credit; neither half is denied.
COMPLETE SAFE, AND THE ORDER OF THE ARMS IS THE PROOF. The percentage question is optional and brand new, so the FIRST arm is the one every return in the tree takes: line 10 unanswered resolves $0 without reading the attestation, the MAGI test or anything else, and an unanswered line 9 does the same. Only a return that has ANSWERED line 10 reaches the gates, so no existing fixture can be made Incomplete by this fact.
THE GATES ARE THE PERSONAL SIDE'S GATES, deliberately. The printed schedule stops a filer at line 5, 8a, 8d or 8e before they ever reach line 10, so a return that fails the collapsed attestation or the both years MAGI test has NO line 11 amount either, and the business half must not escape a limit the personal half obeys. A transferred credit is likewise $0 on both sides. A computed line 11 also needs the Schedule A line 2 VIN on the return, as line 12 does (IRC 30D(f)(9) allows no credit under the section without it): with the VIN unanswered this line is Incomplete, not a credit. An attested filer whose MAGI cannot be decided leaves this line Incomplete rather than $0, exactly as /newCleanVehiclePrimaryCreditBeforeTaxLimit does.
THE BASE IS THE CAPPED LINE 9, so line 11 and line 12 foot to the same number the section 30D(b) per vehicle ceiling allows, and 100 percent business use leaves line 12 at $0.
PER VEHICLE RESIDUAL, NAMED RATHER THAN SILENT: the /additionalNewCleanVehicles collection on this module has no percentage of its own and is still wholly personal, because form3800 line 1y reads only this scalar fact and a per item aggregate would have no consumer. A filer with business use on a SECOND vehicle belongs on the Schedule A copy collection, whose own line 10 and line 11 boxes are form8936sa /form8936Vehicles/*/writableBoxf220 and writableBoxf230.

Fact.Name: Business or investment use percentage of the new clean vehicle (line 10)
Fact.Description:
Schedule A (Form 8936) line 10, the business and investment use percentage of the vehicle on this module's legacy single vehicle (scalar) path: the filer's /writableNewCleanVehicleBusinessUsePercentage where they have answered it, and 0 percent where they have not. THE STRUCTURAL 0 IS GONE and its stated reason was stale: it read "because Form 3800 is deferred by this module's own scope ledger row", and Form 3800 is built - form3800 /form3800PartIiiLine1yCredit reads this line's product (/newCleanVehicleBusinessUsePartOfCredit) as its first addend on the scalar path. See that fact for the split, the gates and the per vehicle residual.
UNANSWERED IS 0 PERCENT, NOT INCOMPLETE, and that is what keeps every committed return exactly where it was: a wholly personal use vehicle is the reading the printed line gets from a filer who drove no business miles, and it is the reading this module gave every return before the intake existed.

Fact.Name: 2025 MAGI exceeds the new clean vehicle limit (Schedule A (Form 8936) line 8c, Yes)
Fact.Description: The Yes box of Schedule A (Form 8936) line 8c: Form 8936 line 2 (2025 modified AGI) is more than the Part II and Part III limit shown on the chart below Form 8936 line 5 for the 2025 filing status. Both operands already exist, so the box is a comparison rather than a question: /cleanVehicleCurrentYearMagi against /newCleanVehicleMagiThreshold.

Fact.Name: 2025 MAGI is within the new clean vehicle limit (line 8c, No)
Fact.Description: The No box of Schedule A (Form 8936) line 8c: the negation of /newCleanVehicleCurrentYearMagiExceedsLimit. The printed form skips line 8d for this filer, which is why the line 8d boxes below carry the line 8c answer as a conjunct.

Fact.Name: 2024 MAGI also exceeds the new clean vehicle limit (Schedule A (Form 8936) line 8d, Yes)
Fact.Description: The Yes box of Schedule A (Form 8936) line 8d: the filer was over the Part II and Part III limit in 2025 (line 8c) and is over it for 2024 as well, so the credit is denied and a transferred amount is repaid. It is the negation of /newCleanVehicleMagiAllowsCredit, which already encodes the printed both years rule and the skip routing, so the two cannot disagree. AN UNANSWERED 2024 MAGI CHECKS THIS BOX, and that is disclosed rather than silent: this module reads a missing prior year as also exceeding the limit in both directions, so the printed box shows the graph's own belief where a filer might instead leave line 8d blank until they look up their 2024 return.

Fact.Name: The new clean vehicle was not acquired for use or lease (line 8e, No)
Fact.Description: The No box of Schedule A (Form 8936) line 8e: the negation of /writableNewCleanVehicleAcquiredForUseOrLease. The printed form stops Part II here.

Fact.Name: Personal use part of the new clean vehicle credit (Schedule A (Form 8936) line 12)
Fact.Description: Schedule A (Form 8936) line 12, line 9 minus line 11, the Part III personal use credit amount that Form 8936 line 9 carries into the section 30D credit. Written as the printed subtraction rather than as an alias of line 9 so that it keeps footing when line 11 is nonzero: /newCleanVehicleBusinessUsePartOfCredit is the line 10 percentage times the capped line 9 whenever the filer answers /writableNewCleanVehicleBusinessUsePercentage. The credit chain subtracts the same amount at /newCleanVehiclePrimaryCreditBeforeTaxLimit, off the capped line 9, so this printed line and the amount that reaches Schedule 3 line 6f agree on every return; they differ only if a line 9 above $7,500 were ever accepted, which the intake's own Limit forbids.

Fact.Name: 2024 MAGI is within the new clean vehicle limit (line 8d, No)
Fact.Description: The No box of Schedule A (Form 8936) line 8d: the filer reached line 8d because 2025 MAGI exceeded the Part II and Part III limit, and their 2024 MAGI does not exceed it, so the both years test does not deny the credit. Both conjuncts are required because a filer whose 2025 MAGI is within the limit never answers line 8d at all.

Fact.Name: This Form 8936 is filed with an individual income tax return (line 8b)
Fact.Description: The Yes box of Schedule A (Form 8936) line 8b. A return that carries one of the five Form 1040 filing statuses IS an individual income tax return, so the answer is the disjunction of the filing status facts rather than a question put to the taxpayer. This is a product scope derivation and it is exact for every return this dictionary can represent: the estate, trust and entity filers line 8b routes to line 8e are outside the Form 1040 perimeter entirely. The eighteen sweep templates carry no constant Bool, and an Any() over the statuses says what a literal True would say without asserting anything the graph does not know.

Fact.Name: This Form 8936 is not filed with an individual income tax return (line 8b, No)
Fact.Description: The No box of Schedule A (Form 8936) line 8b: the negation of /returnIsIndividualIncomeTaxReturn, which the printed form routes past lines 8c and 8d straight to line 8e. On a Form 1040 return with a filing status answered it is false.

Fact.Name: Zero dollars, the comparison floor for the Schedule A (Form 8936) yes or no boxes
Fact.Description: A structural $0 used as the right hand side of the Schedule A (Form 8936) comparisons that ask whether an amount exists at all: line 4a (was a credit transferred to the dealer) and line 4b (is a transferred credit being repaid). It encodes no statutory figure and prints nowhere.

Fact.Name: Clean vehicle credit transferred to the dealer for this vehicle (line 4a amount)
Fact.Description: The amount printed on Schedule A (Form 8936) line 4a: the credit the taxpayer transferred to a registered dealer at the time of sale, from the seller's report, for the vehicle this Schedule A covers. A Schedule A is filed per vehicle and the two transfer intakes are split by credit type, so the printed box is the NEW transfer when line 5 says the VIN belongs to a new clean vehicle and the PREVIOUSLY OWNED transfer otherwise, which is the routing the printed schedule itself uses (line 5 to Part II, line 6 to Part IV).

Fact.Name: Denominator of the 30 percent previously owned clean vehicle credit rate
Fact.Description: The constant 100, the percent denominator that turns /usedCleanVehicleCreditRateNumerator into the 0.30 rate Schedule A (Form 8936) line 15 prints as "30% (0.30)". A rate encoding, declared structural. It is never zero, so the ratable shape's zero whole guard cannot fire and line 15 is always the rounded product.

Fact.Name: Numerator of the 30 percent previously owned clean vehicle credit rate
Fact.Description: The constant 30, the numerator of the 30% rate Schedule A (Form 8936) line 15 applies to the sales price on line 14. A rate encoding, declared structural: it is not a statutory dollar amount, it is half of the fraction /usedCleanVehicleThirtyPercentOfSalePrice divides by /usedCleanVehicleCreditRateDenominator. It exists only because the ratable shape takes its part and whole as facts.

Fact.Name: 2025 MAGI exceeds the previously owned clean vehicle limit (line 13b, Yes)
Fact.Description: The Yes box of Schedule A (Form 8936) line 13b: Form 8936 line 2 (2025 modified AGI) is more than the Part IV limit shown on the chart below Form 8936 line 5 for the 2025 filing status. The section 25E twin of /newCleanVehicleCurrentYearMagiExceedsLimit, measured against /usedCleanVehicleMagiThreshold.

Fact.Name: 2025 MAGI is within the previously owned clean vehicle limit (line 13b, No)
Fact.Description: The No box of Schedule A (Form 8936) line 13b: the negation of /usedCleanVehicleCurrentYearMagiExceedsLimit. The printed form skips line 13c for this filer.

Fact.Name: 2024 MAGI also exceeds the previously owned clean vehicle limit (line 13c, Yes)
Fact.Description: The Yes box of Schedule A (Form 8936) line 13c: the filer was over the Part IV limit in 2025 (line 13b) and is over it for 2024 as well, so the credit is denied and a transferred amount is repaid on Schedule 2 line 1c. It is the negation of /usedCleanVehicleMagiAllowsCredit, which already encodes the printed both years rule and the skip routing. AN UNANSWERED 2024 MAGI CHECKS THIS BOX, the same disclosed convention as the section 30D twin.

Fact.Name: Maximum previously owned clean vehicle credit amount (Schedule A (Form 8936) line 16)
Fact.Description: Schedule A (Form 8936) line 16, the printed "Maximum vehicle credit amount . . . $4,000". The statutory ceiling of IRC 25E(a)(1), carried on param ledger row used-clean-vehicle-max-credit, which is the same ledger id the shipping fact /usedCleanVehicleTentativeCreditAmount annotates on its own $4,000 literal. A constant with no dependencies: it prints on every rendered copy of Part IV.

Fact.Name: Previously owned clean vehicle was not acquired for use (Schedule A (Form 8936) line 13f, No box)
Fact.Description: The No box of Schedule A (Form 8936) line 13f, printed "No. Stop here. You can't claim a credit amount for a vehicle you didn't acquire for use or acquired for resale." It is the exact negation of the Yes box, so it is derived rather than collected: two independent attestations of one question could disagree, and the schedule offers a single Yes/No pair. Incomplete while the attestation is unanswered, so neither box prints until the taxpayer answers. IRC 25E(c)(3)(B) makes purchase for use and not for resale a condition of being a qualified buyer, which is why a No here stops the Part IV credit.

Fact.Name: No previously owned clean vehicle credit was claimed in the 3 year lookback (13d, No)
Fact.Description: The No box of Schedule A (Form 8936) line 13d: the negation of /writableUsedCleanVehicleClaimedInThreeYearLookback, which the printed form routes on to line 13e.

Fact.Name: 2024 MAGI is within the previously owned clean vehicle limit (line 13c, No)
Fact.Description: The No box of Schedule A (Form 8936) line 13c: the filer reached line 13c because 2025 MAGI exceeded the Part IV limit, and their 2024 MAGI does not exceed it, so the both years test does not deny the credit. Both conjuncts are required because a filer whose 2025 MAGI is within the limit never answers line 13c at all.

Fact.Name: Previously owned clean vehicle sales price ceiling (Schedule A (Form 8936) line 13e)
Fact.Description: The $25,000 sales price ceiling Schedule A (Form 8936) line 13e prints: a previously owned clean vehicle sold for more than this amount does not qualify for the Part IV credit. The figure is already carried as the param ledger id used clean vehicle sale price ceiling inside /usedCleanVehicleTentativeCreditAmount; this fact names it so the printed line 13e boxes can compare against it.

Fact.Name: The sales price of the vehicle is more than $25,000 (line 13e, Yes)
Fact.Description: The Yes box of Schedule A (Form 8936) line 13e, which stops the Part IV credit. Computed from /writableUsedCleanVehicleSalePrice rather than attested, exactly as /usedCleanVehicleTentativeCreditAmount already computes the same ceiling: line 13e and line 14 read one figure, and asking the taxpayer a second time would let the two answers disagree. The test is MORE THAN, not at least, so a vehicle sold for exactly $25,000 leaves this box unchecked.

Fact.Name: The sales price of the vehicle is not more than $25,000 (line 13e, No)
Fact.Description: The No box of Schedule A (Form 8936) line 13e: the negation of /usedCleanVehicleSalePriceExceedsCeiling, which the printed form routes on to line 13f. A vehicle sold for exactly $25,000 checks this box.

Fact.Name: 30 percent of the previously owned clean vehicle sales price (Schedule A (Form 8936) line 15)
Fact.Description: Schedule A (Form 8936) line 15, "Multiply line 14 by 30% (0.30)": the sales price on line 14 times 30 over 100, rounded to whole dollars, which is the same product and the same rounding the shipping fact /usedCleanVehicleTentativeCreditAmount computes inside its line 17 lesser of. THIS LINE IS DELIBERATELY UNGATED. Line 17 applies the Part IV qualification gates and the $4,000 cap; line 15 is the bare arithmetic the schedule prints, so it reads only the sales price and stays Incomplete, printing nothing, until line 14 is answered. No obligation is declared because nothing has to be rewired: line 17's fact already recomputes this product internally, so this fact adds a printed line, not a missing input.

Fact.Name: The VIN on line 2 belongs to a new clean vehicle (Schedule A (Form 8936) line 5)
Fact.Description: TRUE if the vehicle identified in Part I is a NEW clean vehicle acquired before October 1, 2025 (the OBBBA termination date) and placed in service during the tax year, which is the Yes answer to Schedule A (Form 8936) line 5 and routes the schedule to Part II. The graph cannot derive it: only the taxpayer and the seller's report know what the VIN is. PRINT ONLY UNTIL THE ATTESTATION CONSUMES IT: line 5 is today one conjunct of the collapsed /writableNewCleanVehicleQualifiesForCredit, so this fact prints the box while that attestation still gates the credit.

Fact.Name: The VIN on line 2 belongs to a previously owned clean vehicle (Schedule A (Form 8936) line 6)
Fact.Description: TRUE if the vehicle identified in Part I is a PREVIOUSLY OWNED clean vehicle acquired after 2022 and before October 1, 2025 and placed in service during the tax year, which is the Yes answer to Schedule A (Form 8936) line 6 and routes the schedule to Part IV. The graph cannot derive it. PRINT ONLY UNTIL THE ATTESTATION CONSUMES IT: line 6 is today one conjunct of the collapsed /writableUsedCleanVehicleQualifiesForCredit.

Fact.Name: The VIN on line 2 belongs to a qualified commercial clean vehicle (line 7)
Fact.Description: TRUE if the vehicle identified in Part I is a QUALIFIED COMMERCIAL clean vehicle acquired after 2022 and before October 1, 2025 and placed in service during the tax year, which is the Yes answer to Schedule A (Form 8936) line 7 and routes the schedule to Part V. form3800 /form3800PartIiiLine1aaOwnVehicleCredit reads this answer IsComplete-first as the Part V routing gate: Yes, with the line 18b and 18c answers also Yes, carries the Schedule A line 26 credit to Form 3800 Part III line 1aa and on to Schedule 3 line 6a; No carries $0; unanswered on a return whose Schedule A line 26 resolves above $0 leaves Schedule 3 line 6a Incomplete, because the routing answer is owed. This module's own Part V facts still figure the line 26 amount without reading it.

Fact.Name: Clean vehicle make (Schedule A (Form 8936) line 1b)
Fact.Description: The make (manufacturer) of the clean vehicle this Schedule A covers, printed on Schedule A (Form 8936) line 1b. A Part I identifying detail the fact graph cannot derive; the taxpayer transcribes it. Optional.

Fact.Name: Clean vehicle model (Schedule A (Form 8936) line 1c)
Fact.Description: The model of the clean vehicle this Schedule A covers, printed on Schedule A (Form 8936) line 1c. A Part I identifying detail the fact graph cannot derive; the taxpayer transcribes it. Optional.

Fact.Name: Clean vehicle model year (Schedule A (Form 8936) line 1a)
Fact.Description: The model year of the clean vehicle this Schedule A covers, printed on Schedule A (Form 8936) line 1a. Part I identifies the vehicle; nothing on the return computes a year, so the taxpayer transcribes it from the seller's report or the title.
